use_case_name: Transfer a Winning Order to Another Customer

claims.content: An auction participant's order is cancelled because they failed to pay for their winnings within 7 days (168 hours) of the auction ending time.

trigger.raw_text: An auction participant's order is cancelled because they failed to pay for their winnings within 7 days (168 hours) of the auction ending time.

claims.content: The automated email offering the item to the second-place finisher will not be sent if that customer's bid is below the item’s unit cost.
The automated email will not be sent to the second-place finisher if they have two accounts and are essentially bidding against themselves (shill bidding).

Before sending the email, the system compares the second-place finisher's account data to the winner's. The email will not be sent if matches are found on any of: Customer Name, Customer Phone Number, Customer Email Address, Customer Member ID, or Customer Billing and/or Shipping Addresses.
If the second-place finisher does not respond to the 2nd-Chance email within 72 hours after it is sent, the item will be returned to auction available inventory and rescheduled for a future auction.
